name: check_calendar_availability
description: Check live Cal.com availability only after the caller provides a preferred date or date range and time preference. Never claim a slot exists unless this tool returns it.

start_date.description: First date to search in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: Last date to search in YYYY-MM-DD format, no more than 14 days after start_date.

time_zone.description: Caller's IANA timezone, for example America/Chicago.
